mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 70 degrees with overcast skies at Verona City Hall and a new moon in the sky. The temperature will dip to a low of 65 degrees overnight, and there is no rain in the forecast.

The Verona Senior Center is looking for volunteers to help with various programs. You will need to commit to two times per month and potentially help with some light physical tasks. Also, keep an eye out for official notices regarding the upcoming August partisan primary and November elections.

We have a busy couple of days ahead with live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee happening today. Tomorrow, you can visit the Dane County Farmers' Market, catch live music at Paddy Mac's, or head underground for the Cave Carnival at Cave of the Mounds.
Regarding local public safety, on August 6, an officer conducted a traffic stop that resulted in the arrest of a 49-year-old man for an O W I, his fourth offence.
The flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. Culver's is open until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a sweet treat.
